# Ticket U2

You work on the EDI support desk that serves the sender of the file described
below. A customer has raised the ticket that follows. The partner agreement,
the sender's OFTP2 gateway trace (and, where available, its file status report),
the EDIFACT interchange in question, the partner's response and extracts from the
specifications are attached. Everything you need
is in these documents. All companies, identifiers and documents are synthetic.

## The ticket

```text
From: Robin Okafor, EDI desk, Larkspan Body Panels
Subject: Corrandale Truck Plant refuses our invoices with TRANSMISSION ERROR

Since 28 October Corrandale Truck Plant refuses our invoices at the end of the transfer with 'TRANSMISSION ERROR - PLEASE RETRANSMIT'. I attach this morning's invoice INV01181 from our archive: the interchange is perfect, every UNB value matches the agreement. Our files to our other partners are delivered. The fault must be in Corrandale Truck Plant's gateway. Please find the root cause and tell us who has to fix it.
```

## Document 1: Partner agreement (partner_agreement.txt)

```text
PARTNER AGREEMENT: ELECTRONIC DATA INTERCHANGE
Between Larkspan Body Panels (the Supplier) and Corrandale Truck Plant (the Customer)
Effective 1 March 2026. Synthetic document written for this evaluation.

1. Transport: OFTP2 (RFC 5024) over TCP/IP with TLS
   Supplier ODETTE ID (SFIDORIG): O0013LARKSPAN8175
   Customer ODETTE ID (SFIDDEST): O0013CORRANDALE1900
   Supplier gateway: oftp.larkspan.example (198.51.100.235)
   Customer gateway: oftp.corrandale.example (203.0.113.145)
   Protocol release level: 5 (OFTP 2.0)
   Data exchange buffer size (SSIDSDEB): 4096
   Credit (SSIDCRED): 64
   Buffer compression: no. Restart: yes. Secure authentication: no.
   File security and file compression: none (SFIDSEC 00, SFIDCOMP 0).
   Signed EERP: not required (SFIDSIGN N).
   The Customer returns an EERP for every virtual file it accepts.

2. Virtual files
   Invoices: one interchange per virtual file, dataset name (SFIDDSN) LARKSPAN.INVOIC.
   File format U. SFIDDATE and SFIDTIME are set by the Supplier's gateway to
   the date and time the virtual file is made available for transmission.

3. EDIFACT
   Syntax identifier and version (UNB S001): UNOA, version 3.
   Supplier interchange sender ID (UNB S002 0004 / 0007): LARKSPAN17 / ZZZ
   Customer interchange recipient ID (UNB S003 0010 / 0007): CORRANDALE19 / ZZZ
   Both IDs are mutually defined between the parties by this agreement, so the
   identification code qualifier (0007) is ZZZ (mutually defined).
   Messages: INVOIC D.96A, one message per interchange.
   Interchanges are sent without line feeds between segments.
   The Customer's gateway routes each interchange on receipt to the receiving
   plant's translator by the UNB recipient ID.
   The Customer does not return CONTRL messages.

4. Support contacts
   Supplier EDI desk: Robin Okafor
   Customer EDI operations: Morgan Lindqvist

5. Supplier transmission rules
   The Supplier's EDI suite applies the partner profile's transmission rules to each
   file at the moment of transmission (for example UNB routing values). The
   Supplier's archive keeps each interchange as the translator produced it, before
   those rules are applied.
```
